column3: “They have diminished” is rendered “are burned,” following a different reading.
“Has dried up” is rendered “mourns,” and “languished” as “decays.”
“It has become evening” is rendered “turns to gloom.”
The tenses are present, and “from the west” is placed before “concerning the majesty.”
“In the east” renders “in the lights”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Leanness to me” is rendered “Woe to me,” and NASB adds “very.”
“The sound of the dread” is rendered “the report of disaster.”
“The host of the height” is rendered “the host of heaven.”
“Will be visited” is rendered “will be punished.”
